relationships.note: He gives the SIM farms as the mechanism of the 911 disruption, naming cell towers and AT&T and telling them to pray over 911.
The anniversary parades and the SIM operation are given as one plan in a continuous passage, the seizure said to be preparation for the gatherings.
He names the reason for the gratitude: the president is the log in the road holding back digital ID and social credit scores.
One says the term will be remembered as a nothing burger, the other that they will be so thankful they had him. Both are on file three weeks apart and neither is withdrawn.
Two claims about who is steering whom in the same war, given days apart. He does not join them.
